Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: FOUR whole-body approach / combat-advance pose variants for Rica in an existing 2.5D anime game.
Image1 is the exact identity, costume and shovel. Image2 is a shoulder-level ready reference for stronger stages. These are NEW MOVING READY POSES, not idle stances and not an attack impact.
Create one transparent RGBA sheet, exactly TWO ROWS by TWO COLUMNS, four separated complete figures in chronological row-major stage order. All face SCREEN RIGHT, fixed front-right 3/4 camera and consistent full-body proportions/size. Give each entire figure and entire shovel generous transparent space with no cropping and no neighboring overlap.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Rica must visibly carry her weapon READY while ADVANCING toward an enemy, rather than gliding in her relaxed standing portrait. Show forward lean, low athletic center of gravity, one boot stepping ahead and the trailing heel raised, cloak and single braid flowing backward to screen LEFT. These are single forward-advance poses, not a running sprite sequence. Exactly four distinctly staged ready-to-move silhouettes:
TOP LEFT, stage0 novice: modest forward lean, cautious short running step, BOTH hands gripping the shaft in front of her waist; broad metal spade low to screen RIGHT, shaft diagonal down-right, ready to lift for an overhead shovel strike.
TOP RIGHT, stage1: lower knees, stronger forward drive, torso coiled but FACE and chest still toward screen RIGHT. Both hands hold shovel across the WAIST in a compact horizontal guard, steel spade pointing SCREEN RIGHT. Ready to flow into a full-body horizontal spin, no premature strike.
BOTTOM LEFT, stage2: powerful advancing stance, BOTH hands braced near her right shoulder, wooden shaft diagonal UP-RIGHT and large steel spade raised above/in front of the shoulder. Back foot pushes off, cloak trails left. The game will form a greatsword around this real shovel, but draw only its physical shovel core.
BOTTOM RIGHT, stage3: stylish low forward burst, deep lean toward SCREEN RIGHT, front knee advancing; BOTH hands carry the shovel low beside/behind her LEFT hip with the broad steel spade trailing to SCREEN LEFT, ready to bring it around into a forward thrust. Face and eyes firmly on the enemy to SCREEN RIGHT. Cape and braid stream backward. Athletic preparation, not falling, kneeling, attacking or resting.
Exact character: petite ADULT silver-bob elf woman with long pointed ears and exactly ONE continuous braid, charcoal hood DOWN cape, dark teal long-sleeve dress, worn tan work apron, belt with keys/rope, brown fitted gloves and brown boots. Same adult face and costume as references. ONE rigid gravedigger shovel, identical length throughout: one straight wooden shaft, one D-shaped grip at one end, one broad pointed steel spade at the other. Exactly TWO arms and TWO hands plausibly gripping the same shaft. No changed clothing, no extra weapons or hands. If braid streams left, do NOT also draw a second braid hanging on chest.
Polished detailed anime game illustration matching the current assets. Actual transparent alpha, no backdrop, no floor, no shadows, no glow, magic, energy blade, motion trails, speed lines, text, numbers, labels or borders. All four FULL BODY figures and all weapon ends must fit inside their own areas.
